title: ripr agent packet --seam-id --json
description: The document `ripr agent packet --root PATH --seam-id ID --json` writes to stdout on success (exit 0): the agent-seam-packets envelope with the selected seam's packet. The `--gap-ledger` document and the refusal envelope (`agent-packet-refusal.schema.json`) are separate documents. Static advisory evidence only: a conforming packet is not runtime proof, coverage, or mutation adequacy.

analysis_outcome_status.description: The seam route never requires an AnalysisOutcome artifact.

run_status.description: One selected seam is never capped, bounded or declined.

packets.description: The selected seam's packet; empty only when the seam is outside the packet queue (for example strongly gripped under a policy that includes it).

packet.description: One agent packet for the selected seam.

target_kind.description: Present only when the recommended test is a producer-owned new test.

assertion_shape.description: Typed assertion guidance; null when the seam is neither repair-safe nor opaque.

next.description: The commands that close the repair loop for the selected root: snapshot, edit, snapshot, verify, receipt.

proof_obligation.description: Advisory boundary proof obligation for a Rust predicate-boundary seam that is one `<`, `<=`, `>` or `>=` comparison. It is never read for actionability.

related_test_reference.description: A related test named as a pattern, with the reason it was chosen.

drafted_boundary.description: The concrete equality-boundary call behind a missing discriminator.

expected.description: Omitted when the static fold could not name the expected value.

evidence_record.description: The seam's Lane 1 evidence record (its own `schema_version` `0.1`).

presentation_text.description: The packet's evidence record carries no presentation text.

statically_contradicted_related_tests.description: Present only while related tests statically contradict the seam; counts the full related set, not the capped `related_tests` list.

command_spec.description: A typed command route, the shape `repair-assurance.schema.json` publishes as `command_spec`.

working_directory.description: Relative to the workspace root: no drive or scheme prefix, no leading separator and no `..` segment (the same constraint as `repair-assurance.schema.json`).
